findings.title: Repeated contract validators have already diverged
findings.suggested_fix: Choose whether 7200 seconds is part of the portable v2 contract. If it is, add the bound to contracts/analysis-v2.schema.json and enforce it in the Python loader; if it is only an iOS import policy, remove it from Manifest.validate and keep it in LocalLibrary.importVideo/importPackage with a policy-specific error. Add shared over-limit and boundary fixtures that both Python and Swift contract tests consume so platform validators cannot drift unnoticed.

testing_gaps: No shared contract fixture exercises a duration above 7200 seconds through both the Python and Swift v2 loaders.
